about: Magic Postcard place templates. Each one is a square picture (stock/<id>.jpg, plus a 240px copy in stock/thumbs/) and how it comes alive: 'video' (a made video, MP4 + WebM with the same name) or 'live' (Art Alive effects drawn live on the phone, no video). x and y run 0..1 across and down the picture. See animate.js for what each live setting does. Optional 'sound': a 16-second soundscape loop (see sound.js) that plays in step with the animation.

templates.title: Asbury Park boardwalk
templates.blurb: Day turns to a golden sunset, night falls, the windows light up and fireworks burst over the boardwalk.

templates.title: Gulf Shores at sunset
templates.blurb: The Gulf sunset fades, the moon rises over the water with its silver path, the surf glows blue-green as it breaks and the sky fills with twinkling stars.

templates.title: Denali
templates.blurb: Alpenglow fades on Denali, then the northern lights dance across the sky above the mountain and the stars shine in the tundra pond.

templates.title: Grand Canyon at golden hour
templates.blurb: Golden light deepens into sunset, then night falls over the canyon: the moon rises with a shimmering flare, the Milky Way arches overhead, the stars twinkle and a shooting star streaks past.

templates.title: Buffalo National River
templates.blurb: Autumn leaves drift past the bluffs, night falls over the river, the moon rises with its silver path on the water and the stars come out.

templates.title: Yosemite Valley

templates.title: Maroon Bells

templates.title: Covered bridge in autumn
templates.blurb: Autumn leaves drift down, lanterns light up inside the old covered bridge and glow on the river, and moonlight shimmers on the water under the stars.

templates.title: Salt marsh at sunrise
templates.blurb: The sun sets over the marsh, mist settles, fireflies blink in the grass, and the moon rises low with its silver path on the water under a sky full of twinkling stars.

templates.title: Everglades at dawn
templates.blurb: Mist hangs over the Everglades, the moon glows through the cypress, fireflies drift over the still water and the egret keeps watch under the stars.

templates.title: Live oak avenue
templates.blurb: Evening falls under the old live oaks, mist drifts along the road, moonlight filters through the Spanish moss and fireflies light up the avenue.

templates.title: Na Pali Coast, Kauai
templates.blurb: The sun sets behind the cliffs, the moon rises over the Pacific with its silver path on the waves, the surf glows blue-green as it breaks, mist drifts through the valley and the sky fills with twinkling stars.

templates.title: Sawtooth Mountains
templates.blurb: Night falls over the Sawtooths, the Milky Way and moon rise over the jagged peaks, stars twinkle in the mountain lake and fireflies drift over the wildflowers.

templates.title: Starved Rock waterfall
templates.blurb: The waterfall keeps flowing as night falls over the canyon, mist rises from the pool, moonlight glints on the water and fireflies fill the forest.

templates.title: Indiana Dunes on Lake Michigan

templates.title: Farm in summer

templates.title: Flint Hills prairie at sunset

templates.title: Bluegrass horse farm at dawn
templates.blurb: Dusk falls over the bluegrass, mist fills the valley, fireflies dance over the pasture and the moon rises over the hills under twinkling stars.

templates.title: Bayou at dawn
templates.blurb: Dusk settles over the bayou, mist drifts between the cypress trees, a lantern glows on the old dock, the moon shines through the haze and fireflies fill the swamp.

templates.title: Maine coast at sunrise

templates.title: Chesapeake Bay at sunset

templates.title: Cape Cod lighthouse

templates.title: Pictured Rocks on Lake Superior
templates.blurb: Night falls over Lake Superior, the northern lights ripple green and violet over the cliffs, and the moon lays its silver path across the water under twinkling stars.

templates.title: Northwoods lake at sunrise

templates.title: Natchez Trace Parkway

templates.title: Ozark river

templates.title: Glacier National Park

templates.title: Chimney Rock

templates.title: Lake Tahoe

templates.title: White Mountains in fall

templates.title: Jersey Shore boardwalk
templates.blurb: The sun goes down over the shore, the moon rises above the Atlantic, the breaking surf glows blue-green, and the stars come out over the boardwalk.

templates.title: Adirondack waterfall

templates.title: Blue Ridge Parkway at sunrise

templates.title: Lancaster County farm
templates.blurb: Cloud shadows drift over the farm, then night falls: the farmhouse windows glow, the barn lights up, and fireflies rise from the fields under the stars.

templates.title: Newport coast

templates.title: Lowcountry at sunrise

templates.title: Black Hills Needles

templates.title: Delicate Arch

templates.title: Vermont village in fall

templates.title: Grand Teton

templates.title: Happy Holidays

templates.title: Just Married
